question: What kind of recipient qualifies to receive a teaching only after having been tested for a full year following prior accomplishment?
premises: The teaching is to be given only to a qualified recipient.
Prior accomplishment marks a necessary condition for reception.
Testing for one year serves to confirm that qualification.
inference: The teaching is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: Criteria for prior accomplishment remain unspecified
plain_english: It is to be given to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
